intro: Rolf and Malakai's Medallions are the service tokens of two Stormwind guards who vanished while patrolling eastern Elwynn Forest. Bearing the insignia of the realm, these items are sought by Guard Thomas to determine the fate of his missing comrades.

p: When guards Rolf and Malakai went missing along the riverbanks of eastern Elwynn Forest, their station commander, Guard Thomas, feared the worst. The recovery of their personal guard medallions provides irrefutable proof of their demise at the hands of the encroaching murlocs. For the Stormwind garrison, these tokens are not mere trinkets; they represent fallen soldiers who held the line against growing wilderness threats when the kingdom's military was stretched desperately thin.
